findings.title: keynv secret list with alias fails to find project
findings.description: When using `keynv secret list @project.env`, the CLI cannot find the project. But `keynv project list` shows the project exists. The alias parsing works for secret create/get but not for list.

findings.title: keynv project describe fails for existing project
findings.description: `keynv project describe testproject` returns 'Project not found' even though `keynv project list` shows the project. This suggests project name lookup is broken.

findings.title: Redactor is working
findings.description: The alias value was redacted in the output - redactor is functioning correctly

commands_tested.error: keynv init requires an interactive terminal. Use the lower-level commands (`keynv project`, `keynv secret`) for scripted setup.

findings.title: keynv init requires interactive terminal - no scripted migration path
findings.description: The help text says 'For scripted migration, use the lower-level `keynv project` and `keynv secret` commands directly' but there's no --yes flag or non-interactive mode. This makes CI/CD integration difficult.
